readmeHtml:
Odoo

Odoo is a suite of web based open source business apps.

The main Odoo Apps include an Open Source CRM, Website Builder, eCommerce, Warehouse Management, Project Management, Billing & Accounting, Point of Sale, Human Resources, Marketing, Manufacturing, ...

Odoo Apps can be used as stand-alone applications, but they also integrate seamlessly so you get a full-featured Open Source ERP when you install several Apps.

Getting started with Odoo

For a standard installation please follow the Setup instructions from the documentation.

To learn the software, we recommend the Odoo eLearning, or Scale-up, the business game. Developers can start with the developer tutorials.

Security

If you believe you have found a security issue, check our Responsible Disclosure page for details and get in touch with us via email.
readmeExcerpt:
# Odoo






Odoo is a suite of web based open source business apps.

The main Odoo Apps include an [Open Source CRM](https://www.odoo.com/page/crm),
[Website Builder](https://www.odoo.com/app/website),
[eCommerce](https://www.odoo.com/app/ecommerce),
[Warehouse Management](https://www.odoo.com/app/inventory),
[Project Management](https://www.odoo.com/app/project),
[Billing & Accounting](https://www.odoo.com/app/accounting),
[Point of Sale](https://www.odoo.com/app/point-of-sale-shop),
[Human Resources](https://www.odoo.com/app/employees),
[Marketing](https://www.odoo.com/app/social-marketing),
[Manufacturing](https://www.odoo.com/app/manufacturing),
[...](https://www.odoo.com/)

Odoo Apps can be used as stand-alone applications, but they also integrate seamlessly so you get
a full-featured [Open Source ERP](https://www.odoo.com) when you install several Apps.

## Getting started with Odoo

For a standard installation please follow the [Setup instructions](https://www.odoo.com/documentation/master/administration/install/install.html)
from the documentation.

To learn the software, we recommend the [Odoo eLearning](https://www.odoo.com/slides),
or [Scale-up, the business game](https://www.odoo.com/page/scale-up-business-game).
Developers can start with [the developer tutorials](https://www.odoo.com/documentation/master/developer/howtos.html).

## Security

If you believe you have found a security issue, check our [Responsible Disclosure page](https://www.odoo.com/security-report)
for details and get in touch with us via email.

aiSummary.oneLiner: An open-source suite of integrated web-based business applications including CRM, eCommerce, and accounting.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Odoo provides a comprehensive suite of open-source business applications designed to manage everyday operations. It covers a wide range of business needs, including CRM, eCommerce, billing, accounting, manufacturing, warehouse, and project management. The core advantage is its seamless integration across all these different modules, eliminating the need for disjointed software systems. Each application can function as a stand-alone tool, but combining them creates a full-featured Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform. It allows businesses to start small with specific modules and scale up their software stack as they grow.
keyFeatures: Integrated apps: connects sales, inventory, and accounting seamlessly to prevent data silos.
Modular architecture: allows businesses to install only the specific applications they currently need.
Open-source ERP: provides a complete enterprise resource planning solution with accessible source code.
Web-based interface: accessible from any browser without requiring local software installation.
Broad business coverage: includes CRM, Point of Sale, HR, marketing, and manufacturing modules out of the box.

useCases.title: Managing sales pipelines
useCases.description: Sales teams track leads and opportunities from initial contact to closed deals using the integrated CRM.

useCases.title: Running an online store
useCases.description: Retailers build and manage their digital storefront, automatically syncing online sales with backend inventory.

useCases.title: Handling business accounting
useCases.description: Finance departments automate invoicing, track expenses, and manage billing within the same system used by sales.

useCases.title: Tracking warehouse inventory
useCases.description: Logistics managers monitor stock levels across multiple locations and automate purchase orders when stock runs low.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Business owners, operations managers, and IT departments looking for an all-in-one platform to run their business. It is suited for companies of all sizes wanting to replace fragmented software tools with a unified ERP.
